scripts.db:reset: docker compose -p ohmyfund-local down --volumes && npm run db:up && npm run db:migrate
scripts.build: npm run build -w @ohmyfund/contracts && npm run build -w @ohmyfund/api && npm run build -w @ohmyfund/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @ohmyfund/contracts && npm run test -w @ohmyfund/contracts && npm run test -w @ohmyfund/api && npm run test -w @ohmyfund/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @ohmyfund/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @ohmyfund/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @ohmyfund/api && npm run typecheck -w @ohmyfund/web
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
